'''Guido Ascoli''' (12 December 1887 – 10 May 1957) was an Italian mathematician, known for his contributions to the [[Partial differential equation|theory of partial differential equations]], and for his works on the teaching of mathematics in secondary high schools.

==Selected publications==
*{{cite web |last1 = Ascoli|first1 = G.|last2 = Burgatti|first2 = Pietro|last3 = Giraud|first3 = Georges|author3-link = Georges Giraud|title = Equazioni alle derivate parziali dei tipi ellittico e parabolico|place = [[Florence]]|publisher = [[Sansoni (publisher)|Sansoni]] Editore|year = 1936|language = it|pages = IV + 186|url = https://matematicaitaliana.sns.it/opere/404/|jfm = 62.0547.04}} (available from the "''[http://mathematica.sns.it/ Edizione Nazionale Mathematica Italiana]''"). A book collecting the winning papers of the 1935 prize of the Annali della Reale Scuola Normale Superiore di Pisa. An English translation of the title reads as:-"''Partial differential equations of elliptic and parabolic type''".
